claims.statement: Crisp offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required.
Crisp centralizes communications from chat, email, WhatsApp and Messenger into one inbox.
Some users report abrupt account suspension without warning, particularly for certain business categories.
Some users find the free plan lacks essential features like automated responses.
Some users report difficulties deleting accounts due to complex workspace removal steps.
Some users report positive experiences with Crisp's API integration and developer support.
Crisp maintains a built-in CRM that synchronizes customer interaction history.
